get.description:
First versus latest scored attempt per trainee and scenario, with cohort statistics.

Observational only: gains can reflect practice with the same scenario, changed difficulty or
selection effects. It is not evidence of training effectiveness on its own
(docs/research/training-effectiveness-study-protocol.md describes a controlled design).

get.description:
Pseudonymised dataset for training-effectiveness analysis (one row per scored session).

Participants appear only as stable codes (keyed HMAC of the account id); names, usernames,
notes and timestamps finer than a day are excluded.

RetentionPolicy.title: RetentionPolicy
RetentionPolicy.description: Data-retention periods. ``None`` disables that rule. Audit events are never deleted.

TrackClassification.title: TrackClassification
TrackClassification.description: Labels a trainee may assign to a track. ``unknown`` is always permitted.

TraineeAction.title: TraineeAction
TraineeAction.description: A single trainee decision. ``client_action_id`` makes submission idempotent.

TraineeOptions.title: TraineeOptions
TraineeOptions.description:
Options an instructor permits a trainee to choose at launch.

Empty lists mean the option is fixed to the scenario's authored value.
